mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) can potentiate the hypotensive effects of torsemide, and torsemide-induced hypokalemia increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias, particularly dangerous with MAOI-related sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective torsemide dose with careful monitoring of blood pressure, serum potassium, and cardiac function.
